Issue body actions

### Which project does this relate to?

Start

### Describe the bug

The issue is simple. I am attempting to use React 19's metadata tags to manage my metadata, but each components is being rendered twice on the DOM, even after adding a key to it. This is in Development and Production.

![Image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/63945639/397728361-9ddf6a1d-f6bd-445c-89b0-b1cf513445d7.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ZFrtxT_YfVTsen0QVsZQDvwCzY8tVTmXoWac4kjgfEc)

I am sure this is SSR issue. Also If someone someone has a solution to dynamically render head meta elements using the router directly that would be great, (I would like the loader context to fetch the updated context not the initial state). My current solution is straight up DOM manipulation.

### Your Example Website or App

edit: [tanstack-react19 Repo](https://github.com/SoloReverse/tanstack-react19)

### Steps to Reproduce the Bug or Issue

Use any tag inside a react component.

![Image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/63945639/397728570-fa6d87dc-9d37-4393-9bf1-5c1c67f9fce8.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..8dGoYauQbwJiQ9PHrdD54gQTipZmh0fRjhadyVaeKVM)

### Expected behavior

Rendering a single tag in the head

### Screenshots or Videos

_No response_

### Platform

- OS: macOS / iOS
- Browser: Chrome and Safari

_No response_

Commenting this line out from

[start/client/Meta.tsx](https://github.com/TanStack/router/blob/main/packages/start/src/client/Meta.tsx)

```
    <>
      {meta.map((asset, i) => (
        <Asset {...asset} key={`tsr-meta-${JSON.stringify(asset)}`} />
      ))}
      <>
```

Seems to fix the problem, however. I don't know why and why is it getting the meta tag from react as opposed to the router.

Pardon for hijacking the discussion. I figured out three different ways to set titles based on dynamically fetched results [#1056 (comment)](https://github.com/TanStack/router/discussions/1056#discussioncomment-12470124) with [start-basic](https://github.com/TanStack/router/tree/v1.125.0/examples/react/start-basic) on 1.125.0 on [https://github.com/yjoer/start-basic-meta/](https://github.com/yjoer/start-basic-meta/). Deduplication works as expected to override the root component's title when the new title is defined through route definitions. However, title updates did not work when using React 19 document metadata in either the component tied directly to the route definition or in a nested, suspended component.

✅ Route definition [yjoer/start-basic-meta@ `b8452e2`](https://github.com/yjoer/start-basic-meta/commit/b8452e251b66c9bbb6ce5e45c77e013e2212f18f)

❎ React 19 document metadata [yjoer/start-basic-meta@ `1ff7472`](https://github.com/yjoer/start-basic-meta/commit/1ff74726983f3fc3b3438ef2f131a1ae7533e8b0)

❎ Suspended components [yjoer/start-basic-meta@ `74ba1d1`](https://github.com/yjoer/start-basic-meta/commit/74ba1d1a5c7d82a777f62f83def7dd704a8f6b83)

2️⃣ In the second scenario, the title is prepended while the root component's title is doubled in the DOM.

![Image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/47742486/442515186-dec0d089-71bf-493d-9681-c4235dc3ed8d.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..aM4DxbgVHS5M-IvcMNSCs9eNMPwbKCi3Togv4XBqhQI)

In the server-rendered markup, the title is prepended, but the root component's title is not doubled.

![Image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/47742486/442515119-a83af976-e596-4d42-b71a-65bb151c2d7b.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..8XLwYnPYpvLN9E_qIoki7HuV_u9wjzPY5NoELXWwRyk)

3️⃣ In the third scenario, the title is completely ignored and fails to be hoisted into the head.

![Image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/47742486/442515383-8a99be8e-d6a9-4e46-bda5-3d53acd2abe6.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..CkCeAsiVnqwHSYPDoV7C0XpJYSTz7qClRcLDlK0T5Oo)

The same applies to the server-rendered markup.

![Image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/47742486/442515356-3f27c78e-8c62-4474-b19f-cdf554ba5cf0.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..3g5v512h6U8kXxNUioGi590t3GKEw7t8EsmmwsZBtzE)
